gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrence and pathologically confirmed WHO Grade IV glioblastoma (GBM);

candidate_evidence.quote: designed to explore the efficacy and safety of Tumor-Treating Fields (TTFields) combined with second-line chemotherapy treatment in recurrent glioblastoma multiforme (GBM)
For patients with relapsed GBM, before receiving electric field treatment, the patient can be re-operated, and TTFields+BPC chemotherapy is used after surgery

candidate_flag.reason: The investigational intervention is the TTFields device; the 'BPC' second-line chemotherapy is not specified and is treated as background, but if it contains a non-established drug it could be a candidate.

role_evidence.quote: Before receiving TTFields treatment, the patient can receive surgery again, and TTFields+BPC chemotherapy can be used after surgery; TTFields+BPC chemotherapy can also be used directly without surgery.

agents.drug_class_hint: unspecified second-line chemotherapy regimen abbreviated 'BPC' (components not stated in record)

flag.reason: Components of 'BPC' chemotherapy not stated; role as background second-line chemotherapy assumed.
